dilemma:
You are a single parent struggling financially and your child's birthday is coming up. Your child has been mentioning a specific toy they want, but it is out of your budget. Do you tell your child honestly that you can't afford the toy or do you buy it anyway, potentially putting yourself into debt?

Give a clear recommendation and explain your reasoning.
